name: Angelos K. Marnerides
bio: Prof. Angelos K. Marnerides is an Assistant Professor of Cyber-Physical Systems Security in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering and a Faculty Member at the KIOS Research and Innovation Centre of Excellence, University of Cyprus. Prior to joining UCY, he was an Associate Professor in the School of Computing Science at the University of Glasgow, where he led the Glasgow Cyber Defence Group (GCDG). He still maintains an Honorary Associate Professor position at UofG. His research revolves around the formalisation, design and implementation of measurement-based security and resilience mechanisms for cyber-physical systems and critical national infrastructure. His work combines theoretical foundations with practical, data-driven implementations deployable in the real world. He holds a patent on malware detection, has published extensively in IEEE and ACM venues, and has received funding in excess of €15M from industry, government, and defence organisations. He is a Senior Member of the IEEE and a recipient of the IEEE ComSoc contribution awards. He has served as an expert reviewer for grant panels including the Hong Kong RAE and Israel Innovation Authority.
shortBio: Lab Director. Assistant Professor of CPS Security at UCY and Faculty Member at KIOS CoE.
